market_summary: Across the entire six-symbol watchlist, the London session is characterized by tight mid-channel consolidations inside session Value Areas without confirmed RVOL expansion. Gold, silver, US tech, and Bitcoin remain capped beneath their session VWAP and EMA50 trend baselines while consolidating near POCs, whereas EURUSD and GBPUSD display compression and volume-divergent pokes near range extremes. With no confirmed institutional breakouts or clean liquidity sweep rejections, all instruments warrant a disciplined HOLD posture until New York session liquidity provides directional momentum.
